subject.title: clawhub install does not register skill hooks automatically

question: Should ClawHub automatically register skill-provided OpenClaw hook bundles during install/update, and what consent, scanner disclosure, and gateway handoff contract must guard that behavior?
rationale: The useful behavior is clear, but accepting it safely changes a security-sensitive runtime boundary for publisher-controlled hook code and requires maintainer intent before implementation.

options.title: Consent-gated hook contract
options.body: Define hook metadata, scanner disclosure, explicit user approval, gateway targeting, restart behavior, and tests before enabling install/update registration.

options.title: Manual registration only
options.body: Keep `clawhub install` as file installation and document manual `openclaw plugins install` registration until OpenClaw exposes a safer handoff surface.

options.title: Unconditional auto-register
options.body: Register hooks immediately after install/update, accepting the security and trust-boundary risk of activating publisher-controlled behavior without a new consent model.

recommendation.title: Consent-gated hook contract
recommendation.body: Define hook metadata, scanner disclosure, explicit user approval, gateway targeting, restart behavior, and tests before enabling install/update registration.

likelyOwner.reason: Patrick-Erichsen is the strongest routing candidate from the CLI install history and related product discussion.
